items.text:
----Review after 0.11 (143 hours playtime)----

Now we have a combat system, not very polished yet but has potential, and devs are fixing things steadily, also the communication between devs and players are good. 
The feeling about this game is completely changed after 0.11(combat) update. Every time you dock a derelict ship, there's chance you may attacked by hostiles, or discover some disturbing 'things'. 
This is the game that I call it "a slice of other people's life, which I never thought I'll enjoy it ever in real life, but here I am", that kind of feeling. 
I hope for NEO Scavenger 2, and still want it badly. But now I also like OSTRANAUTS pretty much. Hope you enjoy. 

----Original review (4.3 hours playtime)----

I like NEO Scavenger, so I think it's okay to support this game.
I just installed it, and I thought: Okay let me just take a look then back to work, half an hour at most.
First I suffocated in my own pressure suit...
Then I open the airlock just want to take a look at the outside, in space...(edit: I think didn't 'opened' the airlock but 'uninstalled' it lol)
I scraped a floor plate to learn how things work... in space, again...
I crashed on a planet because I thought the green circle just meant the orbit of the space station(and actually that's a LAND station lol)...
And so many other embarrassing/hilarious incidents...
Then 4 and half hours just passed. 
My work unfinished. I forgot to eat.
I bought two copies of NEO Scavenger, one on Steam, one on GOG, and I don't know why.
Since this game has no MP either, I hope I will not buy another copy of Ostranauts other than this one, but for some unknown reason, I can't guarantee myself.
Black magic.

ps- Now I encountered some serious bug, and have to stop for a while. But I already have 11 good game hours, better than a lot of soulless, "AAA", "Masterpiece", fancy expensive craps out there. And I will certainly come back as soon as another major update released.

pss- After 0.639 update, the save issue was fixed(the serious bug I mentioned early).
items.text_zh:
----0.11版本后评测（游戏时间143小时）----

现在我们有了一个战斗系统，虽然还不太完善，但很有潜力，开发者也在稳步修复问题，而且开发者与玩家之间的沟通也很好。
0.11（战斗）更新后，这款游戏的感觉完全变了。每次你对接一艘废弃飞船时，都有可能遭到敌对者的攻击，或者发现一些令人不安的“东西”。
这就是我称之为“别人生活的一角，我从没想过自己在现实生活中会享受这种事，但我现在就在这里”的那种游戏，就是那种感觉。
我期待《NEO Scavenger 2》，而且仍然非常想要它。但现在我也很喜欢《OSTRANAUTS》。希望你们玩得开心。

----原始评测（游戏时间4.3小时）----

我喜欢《NEO Scavenger》，所以我觉得支持这款游戏是没问题的。
我刚安装好，心想：好吧，让我看一眼就回去工作，最多半小时。
首先，我在自己的压力服里窒息了……
然后我打开气闸，只想看看外面的太空……（编辑：我想我并没有“打开”气闸，而是把它“卸下来”了哈哈）
我刮下一块地板板件来学习东西是怎么运作的……又是在太空里……
我坠毁在一颗行星上，因为我以为那个绿色圆圈只是空间站的轨道（其实那是一个陆地站点哈哈）……
还有很多其他尴尬/搞笑的事件……
然后4个半小时就这么过去了。
我的工作没做完。我忘了吃饭。
我买了两份《NEO Scavenger》，一份在Steam上，一份在GOG上，我也不知道为什么。
既然这款游戏也没有多人模式，我希望除了这一份之外，我不会再买另一份《Ostranauts》，但由于某种未知原因，我无法向自己保证。
黑魔法。

附注——现在我遇到了一些严重的bug，不得不暂停一段时间。但我已经有11个小时的愉快游戏时间了，比外面很多没有灵魂的、“AAA”、“杰作”、花哨昂贵的垃圾要好得多。而且一旦另一个重大更新发布，我肯定会回来。

再附注——0.639更新后，存档问题被修复了（就是我早先提到的那个严重bug）。
